selection_rationale: Twelve analog consoles chosen to teach the three analog sub-types: small mixers found in every school, rehearsal room and podcast desk (Yamaha MG10XU, Behringer X1204USB, Mackie ProFX12v3, Soundcraft Signature 12 MTK); live consoles from compact 2-bus to 4-bus/matrix FOH desks (Allen & Heath ZED-22FX and ZED-436, Mackie 1604VLZ4, Soundcraft GB4); and studio consoles showing the contrast between true in-line designs (SSL ORIGIN, Audient ASP8024-HE, both used in schools per their makers), a single-path split console (API 1608-II, whose own manual contrasts it with the in-line 2448) and a hybrid DAW-summing console with only two built-in preamps (AMS Neve 8424). Each was kept only when manufacturer documents could be read; historic desks (SSL 4000 E/G) and discontinued live consoles (Midas Venice F, Allen & Heath GL2400) were dropped because their specifications could not be sourced this session.
